map.基于酶抑制率法（GB/T 5009.199），输入对照与样品吸光度变化值，自动计: Based on the enzyme inhibition method (GB/T 5009.199): enter the absorbance change of the control and the sample and it computes the inhibition rate and interprets the result.
map.📖 查看「农药残留酶抑制初筛使用指南」: 📖 Read the "Pesticide Residue Enzyme Inhibition Screening Usage Guide"
map.酶抑制率 =（ΔA₀ − ΔA）÷ ΔA₀ × 100%；对照值 ΔA₀ 须大于: Enzyme inhibition rate = (ΔA₀ − ΔA) ÷ ΔA₀ × 100%. The control ΔA₀ must be above 0.3 and below 0.8 for the test to be valid. When the inhibition rate reaches the judgement threshold (50% by default) the result is positive, suggesting possible organophosphorus or carbamate residues that must be confirmed by gas or liquid chromatography.
map.：样品为阳性，可能含有有机磷或氨基甲酸酯类农药残留: : the sample is positive and may contain organophosphorus or carbamate pesticide residues
map.：结果可疑，建议用色谱法确证: : the result is suspect, so confirm it by chromatography
map.：样品为阴性，农药残留风险低: : the sample is negative and the residue risk is low
map.⚠️ 速测法为初筛手段，阳性结果需用气相/液相色谱法确证。本工具仅供实验室辅助判: ⚠️ The rapid method is only a screen, and a positive result must be confirmed by gas or liquid chromatography. This tool only supports laboratory interpretation.

map.抑制率(%) = (ΔA₀ − ΔA)/ΔA₀ ×100；≥阈值 阳性、15–阈: Inhibition rate (%) = (ΔA₀ − ΔA)/ΔA₀ × 100; at or above the threshold is positive, between 15 and the threshold is suspect, and below 15% is negative.
map.对照 ΔA₀=0.500、样品 ΔA=0.450：抑制率=(0.500−0.45: Control ΔA₀ = 0.500 and sample ΔA = 0.450: inhibition rate = (0.500 − 0.450)/0.500 × 100 = 10%, which is negative and the residue risk is low; at 60% it is positive and must be confirmed.
map.常用 50% 为阳性判据，具体依方法标准；本工具以阈值参数控制。: 50% is the usual positive criterion, subject to the method standard; this tool controls it through the threshold parameter.
map.初筛阴性就安全？: Does a negative screen mean it is safe?
map.仅说明未检出该类抑制，不代表零残留；高风险品仍须色谱确证。: It only means no inhibition of this type was detected, not zero residue; high-risk items still need chromatographic confirmation.
